summary: Former Willamette NF L-4 lookout, Lane County: built 1933-34, firefinder platform 1955, burned for disposal in 1968; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Gone. The register and firelookout.com say gone by 1964; a Forest Service memo describes the house burned in September 1968.

staffing.status: Manned 75 days in 1941; no later staffing in sources

access.note: On Willamette National Forest land, reached by Buck Mountain Trail #3304. No source confirms access to the lookout site itself.

visit.trail_note: Trail #3304 is reached from Blue River via Highway 126 and Forest Road 15. The trail page does not mention the Buck Mountain lookout.

events.note: Announced as one of eleven new emergency lookout stations for the Santiam district.
Newspaper items say the crew finished the lookout house in November 1933. firetower.org gives 1934.
Manned 75 days; reporting station at McKenzie Bridge.
Firefinder platform added to the L-4 cab.
Register and firelookout.com say the cab was gone by 1964.
Forest Service memo dated October 9, 1968: house burned in early September, site cleaned up.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1934 for the L-4 cab. Newspaper items reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page show the lookout house being finished in October and November 1933. The story gives 1933 for construction and notes the 1934 date.

The register and firelookout.com say gone by 1964. A Forest Service memo dated October 9, 1968 says the house was burned in early September 1968. The story reports both dates and does not choose between them.

sources.title: Buck Mountain Trail #3304

notes_for_editor: Two conflicts stay visible in the story: construction in 1933 (newspaper items via the Forest Lookouts page) versus 1934 (register), and gone by 1964 versus burned September 1968. Do not confuse with Buck Mountain in Okanogan County, WA, which still has a standing DNR tower. No source describes the Oregon site today. The Forest Lookouts page quotes newspapers and memos; the originals were not checked.
